newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Bad hygiene killing Moroccan women in labour.
newsitem.headline: Bad hygiene killing Moroccan women in labour.

text.p: Morocco's health minister said on Tuesday that 332 Moroccan women die in labour out of every 100,000 because of bad hygiene and lack of medical care.

"We think the media can help in making people aware of the way to curb illnesses affecting women, including sexually transmissible diseases, maternal mortality and breast and uterus cancers," Health Minister Ahmad Alami said at the start of a two-day national seminar on women and health in the North African country.
Women make up more than half Morocco's 27 million-strong population and 67 percent of them are illiterate, in both rural and urban areas.
Overall, they have a total fertility rate of almost four children per woman compared with seven in 1962.
